listing.name: Need for Speed: Underground 2 / NFSU2Recomp (Apple Silicon)
listing.summary: Play Need for Speed: Underground 2 natively on Apple Silicon Macs (M1+). Static recompilation of the PC game (x86, Direct3D 9) to ARM64 + Metal: no Wine, CrossOver or emulator; 119 fps vs 10-15 fps under Wine. Bring your own copy; no game code or assets included.
